add_expense:
(define (add_expense amount category [note 'omitted])
  (unless (and (real? amount) (> amount 0))
    (error 'add_expense "amount must be a positive number"))
  (unless (and (string? category) (not (string=? category "")))
    (error 'add_expense "category must be a non-empty string"))
  (cond
    [(eq? note 'omitted)
     (let* ([s (get-state)]
            [es (hash-ref s 'expenses '())]
            [e (hasheq 'amount amount 'category category)])
       (set-state! (hash-set s 'expenses (append es (list e))))
       (add1 (length es)))]
    [(string? note)
     (let* ([s (get-state)]
            [es (hash-ref s 'expenses '())]
            [e (hasheq 'amount amount 'category category 'note note)])
       (set-state! (hash-set s 'expenses (append es (list e))))
       (add1 (length es)))]
    [(eq? note 'null) (raise "breaks expenses-shape")]
    [else (error 'add_expense "note must be a string")]))
by_category:
(define (by_category)
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [es (hash-ref s 'expenses '())]
         [cents (for/fold ([h (hasheq)]) ([e es])
                  (let* ([k (string->symbol (hash-ref e 'category ""))]
                         [c (hash-ref h k 0)])
                    (hash-set h k (+ c (inexact->exact (round (* (hash-ref e 'amount 0) 100)))))))])
    (for/fold ([out (hasheq)]) ([(k c) (in-hash cents)])
      (hash-set out k (/ c 100)))))
over_budget:
(define (over_budget)
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [bs (hash-ref s 'budgets (hasheq))]
         [es (hash-ref s 'expenses '())]
         [spent (for/fold ([h (hasheq)]) ([e es])
                  (let* ([k (string->symbol (hash-ref e 'category ""))]
                         [c (hash-ref h k 0)])
                    (hash-set h k (+ c (inexact->exact (round (* (hash-ref e 'amount 0) 100)))))))]
         [over (for/list ([(k b) (in-hash bs)]
                          #:when (> (hash-ref spent k 0) (inexact->exact (round (* b 100)))))
                 (symbol->string k))])
    (sort over string<?)))
set_budget:
(define (set_budget category amount)
  (unless (and (real? amount) (>= amount 0))
    (error 'set_budget "amount must be a non-negative number"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [bs (hash-ref s 'budgets (hasheq))])
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'budgets (hash-set bs (string->symbol category) amount)))
    amount))
top_category:
(define (top_category)
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [es (hash-ref s 'expenses '())])
    (if (null? es)
        'null
        (let* ([cents (for/fold ([h (hasheq)]) ([e es])
                       (let* ([k (string->symbol (hash-ref e 'category ""))]
                              [c (hash-ref h k 0)])
                         (hash-set h k (+ c (inexact->exact (round (* (hash-ref e 'amount 0) 100)))))))]
               [best (for/fold ([best #f]) ([(k c) (in-hash cents)])
                       (if (or (not best)
                               (> c (cdr best))
                               (and (= c (cdr best)) (string<? (symbol->string k) (car best))))
                           (cons (symbol->string k) c)
                           best))])
          (car best)))))
